ZWJ Investment Counsel Inc. Has $28.09 Million Stake in Apple Inc. (AAPL) Posted by Donna Armstrong | Feb 11th, 2018 
ZWJ Investment Counsel Inc. cut its holdings in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 5.5% during the third quarter, according to its most recent disclosure with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The fund owned 182,226 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 10,553 shares during the period. Apple comprises approximately 2.2% of ZWJ Investment Counsel Inc.’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 10th biggest holding. ZWJ Investment Counsel Inc. owned approximately 3,527.94% of Apple worth $28,085,000 at the end of the most recent quarter. 
Several other hedge funds and other institutional investors have also bought and sold shares of AAPL. Insiders have sold 128,412 shares of company stock valued at $22,115,155 in the last ninety days. 0.08% of the stock is currently owned by company insiders. 
Shares of Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ AAPL ) opened at $156.41 on Friday. The stock has a market cap of $793,630.00, a PE ratio of 16.09, a PEG ratio of 1.18 and a beta of 1.33. Apple Inc. has a 52-week low of $132.05 and a 52-week high of $180.10. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a current ratio of 1.24 and a quick ratio of 1.20. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its quarterly earnings data on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share for the quarter, topping the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.37%. The business had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $87.62 billion. During the same quarter in the prior year, the business posted $3.36 earnings per share. Apple’s revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. sell-side analysts forecast that Apple Inc. will post 11.4 EPS for the current year. 
The company also recently disclosed a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, February 15th. Investors of record on Monday, February 12th will be given a dividend of $0.63 per share. The ex-dividend date of this dividend is Friday, February 9th. This represents a $2.52 annualized dividend and a yield of 1.61%. Apple’s dividend payout ratio is 25.93%.

The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
